nodes.description: Ownable.owner: address of the contract owner, written in constructor from msg.sender and changed by transferOwnership/renounceOwnership
BasicToken.balances: mapping(address => uint256) tracking token balances, mutated by transfer/transferFrom and constructor
BasicToken.totalSupply_: total token supply, set once in TokenContract constructor and read by totalSupply()
StandardToken.allowed: nested allowance mapping mutated by approve/increaseApproval/decreaseApproval and transferFrom
TokenContract.name constant string 'SDKTOKEN'
TokenContract.symbol constant string 'SDK'
TokenContract.decimals constant uint8 = 18
TokenContract.INITIAL_SUPPLY constant = 100000000000000000000, assigned to totalSupply_ and holder balance
TokenContract.MAX_SUPPLY constant derived from decimals; declared but never enforced
TokenContract.holder constant address that receives the entire INITIAL_SUPPLY
Ownable constructor: assigns owner = msg.sender, establishing initial access-control authority
transferOwnership(address newOwner) onlyOwner: validates newOwner != 0 and rewrites owner
renounceOwnership() onlyOwner: sets owner = address(0), permanently disabling owner-gated functions
onlyOwner modifier: require(msg.sender == owner); primary access-control gate
SafeMath.mul: computes c = a * b then asserts c / a == b to detect overflow
SafeMath.div: returns a / b without zero-check on b
SafeMath.sub: asserts b <= a then returns a - b, guarding underflow
SafeMath.add: computes c = a + b then asserts c >= a to detect overflow
BasicToken.totalSupply(): view returning totalSupply_
BasicToken.transfer(address _to, uint256 _value): moves balances[msg.sender] to _to using SafeMath and emits Transfer
BasicToken.balanceOf(address _owner): view returning balances[_owner]
StandardToken.transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint256 _value): spends allowance of msg.sender and moves balances
StandardToken.approve(address _spender, uint256 _value): sets allowance; requires _value == 0 or current allowance == 0
StandardToken.allowance(address _owner, address _spender): view returning allowed[_owner][_spender]
StandardToken.increaseApproval(address _spender, uint _addedValue): adds to allowance via SafeMath.add
StandardToken.decreaseApproval(address _spender, uint _subtractedValue): subtracts from allowance with clamp to zero
TokenContract constructor: sets totalSupply_ = INITIAL_SUPPLY, credits holder, emits Transfer from 0x0
TokenContract fallback: payable function that unconditionally reverts, rejecting all plain ether transfers
msg.sender used as ownership identity in Ownable constructor and onlyOwner check
msg.sender used as the implicit account key in balances/allowance mutations across ERC20 functions
Multiplication a * b in SafeMath.mul, protected only by an assert that consumes all gas on overflow
Subtraction a - b in SafeMath.sub, guarded by assert(b <= a) which reverts on underflow
Addition a + b in SafeMath.add, guarded by assert(c >= a) which reverts on overflow
balances[msg.sender].sub(_value) in transfer: allowance of sender balance enforced by require plus SafeMath.sub
balances[_to].add(_value) in transfer: recipient balance increase via SafeMath.add
balances[_from].sub(_value) in transferFrom: sender balance decrease via SafeMath.sub
balances[_to].add(_value) in transferFrom: recipient balance increase via SafeMath.add
allowed[_from][msg.sender].sub(_value) in transferFrom: allowance decrease via SafeMath.sub
allowed[msg.sender][_spender].add(_addedValue) in increaseApproval via SafeMath.add
oldValue.sub(_subtractedValue) in decreaseApproval via SafeMath.sub after clamping to zero
newOwner parameter of transferOwnership, validated against address(0) before ownership transfer
a parameter of SafeMath.mul
b parameter of SafeMath.mul
a parameter (numerator) of SafeMath.div
b parameter (denominator) of SafeMath.div, never checked for zero
a parameter of SafeMath.sub
b parameter of SafeMath.sub
a parameter of SafeMath.add
b parameter of SafeMath.add
_to parameter of BasicToken.transfer, checked against address(0)
_value parameter of BasicToken.transfer, bounded by balances[msg.sender]
_owner parameter of BasicToken.balanceOf used to index the balances mapping
_from parameter of StandardToken.transferFrom, source account debited
_to parameter of StandardToken.transferFrom, destination account credited
_value parameter of StandardToken.transferFrom, bounded by balance and allowance
_spender parameter of StandardToken.approve, allowance beneficiary
_value parameter of StandardToken.approve, new allowance amount
_owner parameter of StandardToken.allowance, key of the outer allowance mapping
_spender parameter of StandardToken.allowance, key of the inner allowance mapping
_spender parameter of StandardToken.increaseApproval
_addedValue parameter of StandardToken.increaseApproval, added to the allowance
_spender parameter of StandardToken.decreaseApproval
_subtractedValue parameter of StandardToken.decreaseApproval, compared to oldValue
c local variable in SafeMath.mul holding the multiplication result before the division assert
c local variable in SafeMath.add holding the addition result before the overflow assert
oldValue local in decreaseApproval caching allowed[msg.sender][_spender] prior to clamping

edges.reason: Ownable constructor writes msg.sender into the owner state variable, making the caller the initial privileged account
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against owner, gating every owner-only function on caller identity
Caller-controlled msg.sender is stored directly in the owner state variable
transfer debits and reads balances indexed by msg.sender
transferFrom reads and debits the allowance entry allowed[_from][msg.sender] for the caller
approve writes the allowance under the msg.sender key
increaseApproval adds to allowed[msg.sender][_spender]
decreaseApproval reads allowed[msg.sender][_spender] into oldValue
Ownable constructor assigns owner = msg.sender
transferOwnership rewrites the owner state variable to newOwner
renounceOwnership sets owner to address(0), renouncing privileged control
transferOwnership execution is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier
renounceOwnership execution is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier
transfer decrements balances[msg.sender] and increments balances[_to]
transfer performs the SafeMath.sub balance decrease on the sender
transfer performs the SafeMath.add balance increase on the recipient
transferFrom debits balances[_from] and credits balances[_to]
transferFrom decrements the allowed[_from][msg.sender] allowance entry
transferFrom runs SafeMath.sub on balances[_from]
transferFrom runs SafeMath.add on balances[_to]
transferFrom runs SafeMath.sub on the caller allowance

increaseApproval stores the increased value into allowed[msg.sender][_spender]
increaseApproval uses SafeMath.add on the allowance
decreaseApproval writes the reduced or zeroed value back into allowed[msg.sender][_spender]
decreaseApproval uses SafeMath.sub when oldValue exceeds the subtracted amount
balanceOf returns balances[_owner] from the balances mapping
allowance returns allowed[_owner][_spender] from the allowance mapping
totalSupply returns the totalSupply_ state variable
TokenContract constructor sets totalSupply_ to the fixed INITIAL_SUPPLY
TokenContract constructor credits the whole supply to the hard-coded holder address
TokenContract constructor reads the INITIAL_SUPPLY constant

_to parameter identifies the credited account in transferFrom
